note: Rival scene. Subtitles (one or two lines) in the bottom letterbox, rows 196-216. The rival's monologue is on dark screens with sparks (rows 116-124): only the text is erased. The big kanji titles (649-753) are artwork and stay; their translation goes in the black band below, one line inside one macroblock row (rows 192-207) so the busy frames have bits left for it.

subtitles.text:
I never thought you'd
make it this far...

I'll finish this thing off
and take its power for myself.
wounding the earth... after the slaughter,
what is gained is the power of desire.
Coming here made it clear to me.
I was called by this tower...

If you get in my way...
I won't hold back, even for you.
